rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for an electronic reverb effect in audio or music.

example.english: The sound engineer said the track needs a little reverb; it will sound more spacious.
example.traditional: 錄音師話段聲要加少少混響，聽落會有空間感。
